dataset.method: Ustawa Prawo ochrony środowiska, art. 321f pkt 2: the opłata emisyjna (emission fee) on diesel oil, PLN 80 per 1,000 litres, in the consolidated texts Dz.U. 2024 poz. 54 and Dz.U. 2025 poz. 647. It is a fixed amount per litre, not priced on CO2; the producer or importer pays it with the excise duty and passes it on in the pump price, so a trip pays it where its fuel is bought. Litres are the trip's road fuel as given (diesel_l), or its tank-to-wheel CO2 at 2.67 kg per litre of diesel (EN 16258:2012).
